ei.title: The Hidden Labor in a Computerized Era
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: The promise of a computerized society, we were told, was that it would pass to machines all of the repetitive drudgery of work, allowing us humans to pursue higher purposes and to have more leisure time. It didn't work out this way. Instead of more time, most of us have less. Companies large and small have off-loaded work onto the backs of consumers. Things that used to be done for us, as part of the value-added service of working with a company, we are now expected to do ourselves. With air travel, we're now expected to complete our own reservations and check-in, jobs that used to be done by airline employees or travel agents. At the grocery store, we're expected to bag our own groceries and, in some supermarkets, to scan our own purchases.

questions.passage: The promise of a computerized society, we were told, was that it would pass to machines all of the (A)[repetitive / creative] drudgery of work, allowing us humans to (B)[avoid / pursue] higher purposes and to have more leisure time. It didn't work out this way. Instead of more time, most of us have less. Companies large and small have off-loaded work onto the backs of (C)[consumers / producers]. Things that used to be done for us, as part of the value-added service of working with a company, we are now expected to do ourselves. With air travel, we're now expected to complete our own reservations and check-in, jobs that used to be done by airline employees or travel agents. At the grocery store, we're expected to bag our own groceries and, in some supermarkets, to scan our own purchases.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: ③ (A) repetitive(반복적인) (B) pursue(추구하다) (C) consumers(소비자) 원문 그대로
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 반복적인 - 추구하다 - 소비자: 반복적인 고된 일, 더 높은 목적을 추구, 소비자에게 떠넘김 ← 정답
❌ ① creative(창의적인) ≠ repetitive
❌ ② avoid(피하다) ≠ pursue
❌ ④ creative, avoid, producers(생산자) 오류

det.analysis:
✅ ① 더 높은 - 여가 - 완수하다: 더 높은 목적, 더 많은 여가 시간, 예약을 직접 완수 ← 정답
❌ ② lower(더 낮은) ≠ higher
❌ ③ work(일) ≠ leisure, cancel(취소하다) ≠ complete
❌ ④ lower, work 오류

questions.passage: The promise of a computerized society, we were told, was that it would pass to machines all of the repetitive drudgery of work, allowing us humans to pursue higher purposes and to have more leisure time. It didn't work out this way. Instead of more time, most of us have less. Companies large and small have (A)[off-loaded / absorbed] work onto the backs of consumers. Things that used to be done for us, as part of the (B)[worthless / value-added] service of working with a company, we are now expected to do ourselves. With air travel, we're now expected to complete our own reservations and check-in, jobs that used to be done by airline employees or travel agents. At the grocery store, we're expected to bag our own groceries and, in some supermarkets, to (C)[scan / ignore] our own purchases.

det.korean: ④ (A) off-loaded(떠넘긴) (B) value-added(부가 가치의) (C) scan(스캔하다) 원문 그대로

❌ ① absorbed(흡수한) ≠ off-loaded

questions.passage:

questions.passage: The promise of a computerized society, we were told, was that it would pass to machines all of the repetitive drudgery of work, allowing us humans to pursue higher purposes and to have more leisure time. It didn't work out this way. Instead of more time, most of us have less. Companies large and small have off-loaded work onto the backs of consumers. Things that used to be done for us, as part of the value-added service of working with a company, we are now expected __________. With air travel, we're now expected to complete our own reservations and check-in, jobs that used to be done by airline employees or travel agents. At the grocery store, we're expected to bag our own groceries and, in some supermarkets, to scan our own purchases.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 to do ourselves(우리 스스로 하도록)가 적절
det.analysis:
✅ ① to do ourselves(우리 스스로 하도록): 과거에는 우리를 위해 행해지던 일을 이제는 '우리 스스로 하도록' 기대된다 ← 정답
❌ ② to pay extra for(추가 비용을 내도록): 본문 근거 없음
❌ ③ to give up on(포기하도록): 문맥상 부적합
❌ ④ to speed up(속도를 높이도록): 문맥상 부적합
det.tip: we are now expected to do ourselves = 이제 우리 스스로 하도록 기대된다
